Z4)D{=X6GOF%DnBG,~=W.text: This block is the core of the program. It is what makes the particles move. The particles are stored on six lists:-ParticleX (The X position of the particles)-ParticleY (The Y position of the particles)-ParticleXv (How fast the particles are moving on the X axis)-ParticleYv (How fast the particles are moving on the Y axis)-ParticleARGB (The color and transparency of the particles [Alpha, Red, Green, Blue])-Particle Size (The size of the particles)Each particle is stored as item "n" on all of the lists, so it is defined by six numbers.
